items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) is the subject of the interview. The interviewer mentions 'Sweetie' (Annie May) as the sister of the interviewee ('his sister's funeral'). The interviewee does not speak about Sweetie directly in the provided text, nor does he describe a personal relationship beyo

ctx.x: That was in 1966? What sister was this?
When did Sweetie die, Annie May? About 4 years ago. It was in the Fall. That's when he went back for his sister's funeral... He made 'Higgy Comes Home'.

After he finished making it, he came back to New York, right? Then you went back to Atlanta to work a steady job? Oh, for his sister's funeral, O.K., fine. Now, when you put together that record, 'Higgy Comes Home', you and Bud Freeman flew down from New York.
